title: Fake Google Tech Job Offer (Advance Fee)
subtitle: Refundable equipment deposit + Telegram redirect + Gmail recruiter
content:
Dear Candidate,

We are pleased to offer you the position of Senior Cloud Engineer at Google India. Your starting salary will be $145,000 USD per annum with comprehensive health coverage.

Due to remote equipment logistics, you are required to deposit a refundable security deposit of $450 to our verified Bitcoin wallet (bc1qxy2kgdygjrsqtzq2n0yrf2493p83kkfjhx0wlh) or via Zelle to cover transit insurance and your customized Apple MacBook M3 workstation. This payment will be 100% reimbursed on your first payroll cycle.

Failure to complete the deposit within 24 hours will forfeit your candidacy.

Please connect immediately with our Talent Acquisition Director on Telegram at @GoogleLeadRecruiter and confirm your payment receipt.

Warm regards,
Google Talent Acquisition Team
recruitment.google.team@gmail.com

title: Deceptive Luxury Flat Rental Agreement
subtitle: Advance wire before physical viewing + Landlord abroad
content:
Dear Tenant,

To secure the apartment and prevent other applicants from taking it, you must wire the first month rent and security deposit of $1,200 before viewing to my personal Western Union account.

Once the wire transfer is confirmed, the keys will be dispatched via FedEx courier directly to your current address within 24 hours.

Contact me on WhatsApp: +44 7700 900123.

Best,
Dr. Richard Sterling (Owner)
